name: Person Identification
definition: Unique and unambiguous way to identify a person.

SocialSecurityNumber.name: Social Security Number
SocialSecurityNumber.definition: Number assigned by a social security agency.

DriversLicenseNumber.name: Drivers License Number
DriversLicenseNumber.definition: Number assigned by a license authority to a driver's license.

AlienRegistrationNumber.name: Alien Registration Number
AlienRegistrationNumber.definition: Number assigned by a government agency to identify foreign nationals.

PassportNumber.name: Passport Number
PassportNumber.definition: Number assigned by a passport authority to a passport.

IdentityCardNumber.name: Identity Card Number
IdentityCardNumber.definition: Number assigned by a national authority to an identity card.

EmployerIdentificationNumber.name: Employer Identification Number
EmployerIdentificationNumber.definition: Number assigned to an employer by a registration authority.

NPI.name: NPI
NPI.definition: Natural person is identified through the natural person identifier.

Person.name: Person
Person.definition: Person for which an identification is provided.

PersonName.name: Person Name
PersonName.definition: Name by which a person is known and which is usually used to identify that person. It is derived from PartyName (association between PartyIdentificationInformation and PartyName).
